mechanism: Both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism and may compete for CYP3A4/CYP2C8 pathways; albendazole's active metabolite albendazole sulfoxide may inhibit hydroxychloroquine clearance, and both agents can cause CNS effects.
action: Monitor for increased hydroxychloroquine toxicity (visual changes, neuropsychiatric symptoms) and albendazole efficacy; consider therapeutic drug monitoring if available; separate dosing times if possible.
